title: Blue Skies Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Blue Skies is a traditional Seaside beach cottage that will bring back favorite memories of your family's summer vacations. Situated on a beautiful oversized lot on Tupelo Street, there is lots of space to enjoy the outdoors just as much as the indoors.
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Access to the Private Seaside Beaches near TUPELO pavilion - You will have a total of 10 RFID access cards for access to the private beaches in Seaside. - 2 Bikes included!! - Optional access to Seaside's private pools and fitness center (additional fee applies) - Spacious outdoor patios - Fully stocked kitchen complete with standard drip coffee maker - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: - There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. The cost for this cottage is $84/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. --Vacation Cancellation Protection- Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($125 fee applies at booking) Blue Skies is a traditional Seaside beach cottage that will bring back favorite memories of your family's summer vacations. Situated on a beautiful oversized lot on Tupelo Street, there is lots of space to enjoy the outdoors just as much as the indoors. French doors from the front porch welcome you into the living area with a sense of grand spaciousness provided by a vaulted ceiling. Natural finished pine floors are found throughout the cottage. The kitchen has been updated with quartz countertops, tile back splash and stainless-steel appliances. The dining area includes a buffet area to host family dinners. Another set of French doors off the living area leads to a screened back porch for relaxing at the end of the day. The expansive back yard is shaded with mature oaks and magnolia trees and is the perfect setting for outdoor entertaining. A guest bedroom with queen bed and full bath are located on the first level. On the second level is the primary suite with king bed and a private porch. The en suite primary bath has a double vanity, quartz countertops, white tile shower surround and tiled floors. Also on the second level is the laundry area, along with a third bedroom with two sets of bunk beds and its own full bath. All three baths have been completely updated recently. Children will scurry back from the beach to be the first to wash the sand from their bathing suits in the outside shower. Private paved onsite parking. ACCOMMODATIONS: (sleeps 10) Bedroom 1: King master, Private Bath with dual sinks, shower only, TV Bedroom 2: Dual bunk room (sleeps 4-6) with 2 full sized beds on bottom bunks and 2 twin beds on top bunk TV, bath with shower/tub combo Bedroom 3: Located downstairs- Queen with bath (shower only) IMPORTANT DETAILS: * Parking for 2 cars ** There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. This charge is optional with Sandpiper Vacation Rentals. The cost for this cottage is $84/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. Seaside requires the passes to be purchased for the entirety of your stay when ordered. ** Additional fees are required to reserve Pickleball and Tennis courts paid directly to the Seaside amenity Center. * Seaside Chapel with Sunday services, Walkable Town Center from rental home including shopping, restaurants and upscale grocery market. FREE WIFI

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF

all: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
